title: Ukrainian Baked Mackerel with Pilaf
description: A hearty Ukrainian-inspired dish featuring baked mackerel served with a flavorful pilaf. The combination of fish and rice provides a balanced and satisfying meal.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or aluminum foil for easy cleanup.
Place the mackerel fillets on the prepared baking sheet, skin side up.
Drizzle the olive oil over the fish and sprinkle with salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Bake the mackerel in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the fish is baking, prepare the pilaf.
In a large saucepan, heat a couple of tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped carrots and onions and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the uncooked white rice to the saucepan and stir to coat with oil.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan, and simmer for 15-20 minutes, or until the rice is tender.
Fluff the cooked pilaf with a fork and season with salt and pepper to taste.
To serve, place a baked mackerel fillet on each plate and serve with a side of pilaf.
